snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 - Supernova for iPhone, iPad and iPod touch by FISHLABS - Feature Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the special features of Fishlabs' new outer space epic GOF2 - Supernova, which brings unprecedented sci-fi gaming to your Apple-powered smartphone or tablet! For more info, visit http://www.galaxyonfire.com.

The Supernova expansion, which is available in Full HD, HD and SD for all relevant iOS and OSX devices, is jam-packed with all kinds of spectacular features and assets, such as new ships, weapons, star systems, characters and gameplay modes, just to name a few. In the course of its gripping storyline, you will have to face an interstellar catastrophe of epic proportions and experience more than 10 hours of action-packed sci-fi gaming at its best!

SPECIAL FEATURES OF THE SUPERNOVA ADD-ON  (AVAILABLE VIA IN-APP PURCHASE)

• An epic new storyline with more than 10 hours of action-packed sci-fi gameplay
• Eight new spaceships (incl. Most Wanted Ships)
• Dozens of new weapons, power-ups and commodities (incl. cluster missiles and gamma shields)
• New mission types and gameplay modes (e.g. bounty hunting, plasma collecting, hacking)
• Seven new star systems (incl. the spectacular Supernova systems)
• New capital ships and structures (e.g. Vossk Battlecruiser and Mido Mining Plant)

SPECIAL FEATURES OF THE FREE UPDATE (RELEASED SIMULTANEOUSLY WITH SUPERNOVA)

• New arcade mode "Supernova Challenge" incl. iOS6 support
• Six special ships (only available for owners of the Kaamo Club)
• One retro ship (the legendary Gryphon from the original GOF 3D)
• Possibility to modify the stats and capabilities of your spaceships
• Kaamo Club VIP Card (for exclusive discounts on all Kaamo-Offers)
• Four new primary weapons
• Nine new achievements
• Complete German voice-over
• Minor bugfixes and enhancements

Supernova is out now for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch and Mac! Buy it now & Face obliteration in the fires of a dying star!
